description: List the termination records in the Migrant Program Money Register, optionally filtered by agency (a name substring as the record or its program names it, or a short form: FEMA, DHS, USCIS, ICE, CBP, HHS, ACF, ORR, State, PRM, DOJ or EOIR, each resolved to the agency names the data gives; a short form the data does not name returns no rows and the answer lists the agency names in the data), program key and recipient name substring; at most 25 rows, with the full count and the count by record type. Three record types, each verbatim with its date and amount as the record gives it: rows of HHS's TAGGS terminated-grants list, in HHS's own words and columns (total obligated, expended, payment and unliquidated, labelled as HHS labels them) with the list's date; termination and recipient-request texts from the USAspending award records, with the agency's exact words, the action type as filed, the action's obligation and any executive-order tag exactly as the record shows it; and FEMA's Shelter and Services de-obligations of February 10 to 12, 2025, by recipient, each labelled the record gives no reason. A $0 termination action is not the money: any de-obligation is a separate, later action. Terminations appear only in the agency's exact words with their dates; where the record gives no words the answer says the record gives no reason, and an executive-order tag appears only as the record shows it. Governments are kept apart from organisations: every amount names its recipient class from the register's reviewed table, never a single NGO total. A recipient is called an IRS-listed exempt organisation only where the register's IRS EO BMF match stands (by the reviewed EIN, or by exact name and state where the register marks the match by rule), shown with that record; other organisations read organisation, IRS status not matched. The tools never call a recipient nonprofit or faith-based, and no recipient is classified by religion. Every answer carries the register's question note: these records show federal awards and the agencies' own termination records; they do not show how any recipient used the money or why an award was made or ended beyond what the record says. Every answer also carries the side-by-side caption, the as-of and retrieval dates, each file's date, the source page on morvs.ai and the licence. Institutions only: no beneficiary, staff member, executive or sole proprietor is named; withheld recipients and records appear only as counts and amounts. A name that matches only a withheld string answers exactly like a name that matches nothing.

agency.description: Optional agency name substring as the record or its program names it, or a short form (FEMA, DHS, HHS, ACF, ORR, State, PRM, DOJ, EOIR); at most 80 characters.

program.description: Optional program key: orr_uc, orr_refugee_formula, orr_refugee_matching, orr_refugee_discretionary, orr_contracts, state_rp, fema_ssp or eoir_legal_access.

recipient.description: Optional case-insensitive recipient name substring as the record names it, at most 80 characters.

name: migrant_programs_terminations
title: List Migrant Program Award Terminations
